parsed.note_claim: The photo of a Kelly Clarkson cutout at Art of Play appears digitally altered, since reporting shows the actual storefront without it and no coverage or store statements mention such a display.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: A singing and dancing bird automaton named "Molly" is displayed at Art of Play.
parsed.reason: The article covers the incident and describes the store and its actual display (Molly the bird) with no mention of a Kelly Clarkson cutout, which is consistent with the note's absence claim, but it never addresses the photo or says it was altered.
